---
title: Invalid charts
---

```chart
type: '"><script>HOSTILE_TYPE()</script>'
title: '<script>HOSTILE_ITITLE()</script>'
data: { inline: [{ x: 1 }] }
encoding: { x: x }
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Bad data
data: { inline: [{ x: '<script>HOSTILE_DATA()</script>' }] }
encoding: { x: '<script>HOSTILE_ENC()</script>', y: '"><img src=x>' }
unknown: '<script>HOSTILE_UNKNOWN_KEY()</script>'
'<script>HOSTILE_KEYNAME()</script>': 1
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Bad annotations and bins
data: { inline: [{ x: A, y: 1 }] }
encoding: { x: x, y: y }
annotations:
  - { kind: '<script>HOSTILE_KIND()</script>', at: { x: A }, text: '"><script>HOSTILE_ATEXT()</script>' }
binning: { count: '<script>HOSTILE_BINS()</script>' }
```
